voice.welcome: Sunny's garden needs water. Choose a thirsty flower!
voice.choose-again: Which flower should we help next?
voice.controls: Hold the tablet with two hands and tilt gently, or slide the bucket with one finger.
voice.rose-intro: The rose is thirsty. Keep the bucket in the green for three careful steps.
voice.tulip-intro: The tulip is thirsty. A soft breeze is coming. Lean gently to keep the water level.
voice.daisy-intro: The daisy is thirsty. Follow the changing breeze and bring the water safely.
voice.splash: Little splash! Bring the bucket back to the middle.
voice.pour: You made it! Tip the bucket toward the flower.
voice.pour-nudge: Move toward the glowing side and hold it there.
voice.rose-bloom: The rose bloomed! Look at those velvety petals.
voice.tulip-bloom: The tulip bloomed! What a bright garden bell.
voice.daisy-bloom: The daisy bloomed! Sunshine in a flower.
voice.all-bloomed: Every flower is dancing! You're a garden helper.
voice.balance-nudge: The green middle is waiting for the bucket.
voice.replay: The garden always loves another delivery.
